# Mock banner assets

## Trademark and purpose

**The ICPC logo is a trademark of the ICPC Foundation.**

The files in this directory, including `icpc.pdf`, `statements-banner.tex`,
and `statements-banner.pdf`, are included only to mock a statement title or
banner and to illustrate the template layout. They are not official event
artwork and do not imply endorsement, sponsorship, or affiliation with the
ICPC Foundation.

Replace the mock logo, event name, dates, location, and host information with
properly authorized assets and text before using the template for an actual
contest or distributing contest materials.
